prompt: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Kunekune, a rail-thin white fine-fabric humanoid writhing wrongly over a dead-still rice paddy on a white-hot summer noon. ANATOMY: ONE featureless opaque white humanoid made entirely of a THIN STRIP OF FINE FABRIC. One blank narrow head, TWO thin arms and TWO thin legs. Torso almost as narrow as neck, STRAIGHT PARALLEL SIDES through chest-waist-hips, utterly SEXLESS, no bust, no hourglass, no muscular man, no shoulders wider than hips, no curvaceous hips, no human skin. Arms no thicker than narrow strips of cloth. No facial features or fingers [kunekune-urban-legend-c01,c04]. MOMENT: CONVULSE IN PLACE, two separate narrow feet BOTH fixed flat in the wet soil beside the paddy, legs straight and parallel with no raised knee and no contrapposto. Head jerked ninety degrees sideways, neck bent like limp cloth, blank head looming abruptly over low viewer. Torso and BOTH ARMS writhe along their entire lengths with MANY TIGHT UNEVEN KINKS AND WRINKLED RIPPLES like thin cloth whipped violently by a straight gust. Left arm jerks near the body in numerous short crimped waves, right arm shoots lower in a different pattern of short irregular waves. NOT two graceful long S-loops, NOT symmetric ribbons, NOT dancer pose. These are soft fabric deformations, no extra hard joints. The body is caught in a violent involuntary spasm, not a statue [c03,c12,c13]. POWER: impossible continuous wriggling in utterly STILL AIR. All rice stalks stand rigid upright and paddy water is glass-flat with no ripples. No curse, minds, victims, aura or beams. SCALE & CAMERA: ground/water-level camera very CLOSE across the paddy, off-centre, figure occupies RIGHT TWO THIRDS and leans toward the lens, blank head and contorted torso almost too close, feet visible near lower right. Rice and empty dike recede left. Humanlike height, not a giant. Avoid centred formal composition, plinth or graceful balanced silhouette. LIGHT & WEATHER: BLEACHED PURE-WHITE SKY, SUN AT ZENITH OUT OF FRAME, brutal overhead white-hot glare, VERY SHORT HARD BLACK SHADOW touching feet, severe white highlights against dark undersides. HEAT HAZE visibly warps distant rice rows. NO BLUE SKY, NO CLOUDS, NO golden-hour light, no soft ambient daylight. SURFACE: crimped torn-edge fine opaque white cloth, dry paper creases and harsh shadows in each tight ripple. SETTING: wide empty hot-summer rice fields [c01,c11]. MOOD: oppressive close encounter with a living wrongness, disturbing spasm and faceless looming presence, NEVER pretty, whimsical, elegant, sculpture, land art or model. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, logo, border, watermark; no face, eyes, nose, mouth, teeth, extra limbs or fingers; no film/game/anime/comic design, no gore, no magical glow. Square painterly illustration; wrong movement and twisted silhouette must remain alarming at 200px.

visual_requirements.description: Very slender white paper or fine-fabric humanoid; blank featureless head, two arms and two legs
Continuous impossible wriggling of limbs despite completely windless surrounding rice
Wide rice field on a hot summer day

aura: Unnatural limb wriggling in utterly still air (c03/c12/c13), not luminous aura or a visible curse.
artistic_choices: Rail-thin straight torso, parallel narrow hips and no chest or anatomical waist prevent the rejected hourglass mannequin impression.
Tight uneven cloth ripples visualize continuous limb wriggling c12, with no additional limbs or hard joints. Off-centre body leans across still water toward viewer.
Flat bleached white sky, harsh overhead glare and short hard black shadow express hot summer noon; no blue sky, wispy clouds, sunset or romantic light.

rejected_attempts.reason: Redraw Kunekune writhing IN PLACE, not running, leaping or dancing. The very slender white paper or fine-fabric humanoid (kunekune-urban-legend-c01/c04) stays planted in or beside the paddy while its torso twists in an S-curve and both arms undulate in continuous waves like cloth in a strong straight gust (c03/c12/c13). The rice stalks, grass and air around it must stay completely motionless, so the windless wriggle is the visible wrongness. Keep the head blank, with no invented face, eyes or teeth. Use a wide rice field on a HOT summer day (c01/c11): harsh high white sun, heat shimmer, hard deep shadows and an empty dike path, not a golden-hour postcard. Use a low camera along the dike and tight framing so the unnatural limb motion is the subject and reads at 200px. No mind/curse visuals (c08), aura, text or borrowed design.

Keep: one very slender white paper/fine-fabric humanoid with a blank faceless head, two ribbon-thin arms and two legs. Keep the feet planted in or beside the paddy, the rice and water dead still, and humanlike scale (kunekune-urban-legend-c01/c03/c04/c11/c12/c13). Fix: (a) Make the wriggle read as wrong and alive, not graceful. Use a rail-thin, sexless, straight-hipped body, not an hourglass mannequin, with no contrapposto and no knee-forward model pose. The torso and both arms twist in many tight, uneven ripples along their whole length, like cloth whipped in a gale, and the head is jerked to a broken angle. Every rice blade and the water stay motionless around it. (b) Light: a bleached white-hot noon sky, heat haze visibly warping the far paddies, a harsh overhead sun, and a short hard black shadow at the feet. No pale-blue sky with wispy clouds. (c) Composition: a lower, closer, off-centre camera, so the figure looms over the viewer across the still water instead of standing centred on the path like a statue. No face, eyes, mouth, aura, curse or madness effects (c08), and no text.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native 1254px and 200px inspected: narrow sexless cloth humanoid, one sharply sideways blank head, two arms with many tight abrupt irregular kinks rather than graceful symmetric S loops; two straight separate planted legs and no model contrapposto. Right-offset figure leans close across still rice water. Bleached white sky, glaring highlights, hard dark foot shadow and warped distant paddy replace prior soft blue daylight. Uncanny spasm remains alarming at 200px; no face, extra limbs, curse effects, text or aura. All seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px and 420px downscales, and head/torso, both-arm, feet and background crops. What works and answers r03: one white crumpled fine-fabric/paper humanoid (kunekune-urban-legend-c01/c04) with one blank head and no face, two arms ending in crumpled tips with no fingers, and two legs. Both feet are planted in the paddy mud with no contrapposto, and there is no bust or hourglass waist. The head hangs at a broken sideways angle, and the low, off-centre camera has the figure leaning over the viewer. The rice and the paddy water are still, the sky is bleached white and the foot shadow is hard (c01/c11/c12). No text, aura, curse effect or borrowed design. It still fails the sangar test, because the being reads as an inanimate object, not as something alive wriggling wrongly. (1) Nothing moves. Both arms, the head and the body cloth hang straight down under gravity like wet crepe-paper streamers, and the head sags like a sack. Nothing streams or flutters as in the documented 'straight gust of wind' (c12), so the defining wriggle that gives the being its name (c03/c13) is lost, and the requested convulsion reads as slumping. (2) The image is rendered as a photograph of a puffy, crumpled papier-mache effigy standing in a sunny, vivid green paddy. It has a large, lumpy paper-ball head and paper-boot feet. It reads as a scarecrow or an outdoor paper-art installation. That is both the mundane explanation in c10 and the 'sculpture, land art or model' that the receipt's own prompt excluded, and it is not the painterly house style the prompt asked for. The heat haze warping the far rows, asked for in r03 and in the prompt, is not visible; the far line is only pale haze. At 200px it is an odd, sad paper figure in a pleasant field, not something dangerous. It fails Uji Sangar #2, #3 and #7.

correction_notes: Keep: one slender white fine-fabric/paper humanoid with a blank, faceless head, two arms, two legs and no fingers (kunekune-urban-legend-c01/c04). Keep both feet planted in or beside the paddy, the rice and the paddy water dead still, and humanlike height. Keep the bleached white noon sky with a hard, short shadow (c01/c11), and the low, close, off-centre camera with the figure leaning over the viewer. Fix: (a) Make the wriggle visible as motion against gravity, not sagging. Both arms and the loose edges of the torso stream and whip sideways in ONE direction, as if in a strong straight gust (c12). They are lifted horizontally and ripple in tight, uneven waves, with fluttering, snapping edges and slightly blurred tips. Meanwhile every rice blade and the glassy water show absolutely no wind. The contradiction between gale-blown cloth and a dead-still field is the wrongness (c03/c12/c13). Nothing hangs limp. (b) Make it a living presence, not an object. Give it a flat, thin, sheet-like body like a strip of fine cloth (c04), not puffy crumpled paper tubes. Make the head a narrow blank shape of the same cloth, not a large lumpy paper ball, and give it no boot-like feet. Paint it in the house painterly style with visible brushwork, not as a photograph of a papier-mache figure. It must never read as a scarecrow or an art installation (c10 gives scarecrows as the mundane explanation). (c) Show heat haze visibly warping the far paddy line and treeline. No face, eyes, mouth, aura, curse or madness effects (c08), and no text.
